property_summary: For any callee address that successfully accepts a low-level call with value, C.sendMoney completes without reverting (i.e., a successful external call does not cause revert); the mutant inverts the success check so it reverts when the external call succeeds, breaking this rule for some inputs (successful-accepting callees).
change_summary: Invert the success check so the call reverts when it succeeds (logical flip), producing different behavior after successful sends.
